findings.why: Reducing sebum is a claim about changing a body process (sebum production), which sits in the structure/function grey area. It is the product page's own line, but the page is not legal clearance.
findings.fix: Keep it only if legal accepts the page wording; otherwise use appearance-scoped wording such as 'Helps reduce the look of excess shine and pores'.

tone_read: Calm, ingredient-and-concentration-led and instructional, with no fear, hype or emoji. The 'strength stated on the page' clause reads like an internal note.
language_read: The 10% strength is written in the brand format and matches the page. 'For reducing sebum & pores' is the page tagline but is not scoped to appearance the way the brand's hedged copy usually is.
